title: Pure Dracotail
summary: Dracotail is a Dragon and Spellcaster Fusion archetype where every Main Deck monster sets a 'Dracotail' Spell/Trap directly from the Deck whenever it is sent to the GY as material for a Fusion Summon. Led by Ketu Dracotail, Rahu Dracotail, and Dracotail Faimena, the deck snowballs into Dracotail Arthalion and Dracotail Gulamel while disrupting the opponent with Dracotail Flame and Horn.

allow.Filia Regis: Dragon Fusion boss accessible via Rahu Dracotail or Ketu Dracotail that banishes cards from the field or GY as a Quick Effect.
allow.Guardian Chimera: Level 9 Fusion boss that can be summoned on the opponent's turn via Dracotail Faimena to draw cards and pop opposing threats while triggering Dracotail GY Set effects.

main: Dracotail Faimena

Level 5 WATER Spellcaster handtrap that discards itself as a Quick Effect during either player's Main Phase to Fusion Summon a Dragon or Spellcaster Fusion Monster from hand/field, and sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap when used as Fusion Material.
Dracotail Lukias
Level 4 EARTH Spellcaster starter that searches any 'Dracotail' monster on Normal or Special Summon, and sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap from the Deck when sent to the GY as Fusion Material.
Dracotail Mululu
Level 3 DARK Dragon that Fusion Summons a Dracotail Fusion Monster during the Main Phase, and sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap + negates a face-up opponent's monster when used as Fusion Material.
Dracotail Pan
Level 6 WIND Dragon that sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap AND destroys 1 monster on the field when sent to the GY as Fusion Material, and revives a non-Fusion Dracotail if a Fusion Monster is destroyed.
Dracotail Urgula
Level 6 FIRE Dragon that sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap AND destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field when sent to the GY as Fusion Material, and recycles itself to recover a Spellcaster from the GY.
Dracotail Phryxul
Level 2 LIGHT Dragon that revives a Dracotail monster from the GY on Normal/Special Summon, and sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap when used as Fusion Material.
Ketu Dracotail
Signature Normal Spell that adds any 'Dracotail' monster from your Deck to your hand, then immediately Fusion Summons a Dragon or Spellcaster Fusion Monster if your opponent controls a monster.
Rahu Dracotail
Signature Normal Spell that Fusion Summons 1 'Dracotail' Fusion Monster using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field as Fusion Material.
Dracotail Flame
Normal Trap that negates the effects of 1 face-up Spell on the field, then shuffles 1 other Dracotail card from your GY/banishment into the Deck to draw 1 card.
Dracotail Horn
Normal Trap that returns 1 Attack Position monster on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, then shuffles 1 other Dracotail card from your GY/banishment into the Deck to draw 1 card.
Dracotail Sting
Normal Trap that banishes 1 monster and/or 1 Spell/Trap from the opponent's GY, then recycles 1 other Dracotail card to draw 1 card.
extra: Level 8 EARTH Dragon Fusion boss that bounces monsters on the field and/or GY to the hand up to the number of hand materials used, and revives itself from the GY when 2+ monsters are sent to the GY.

Level 9 WATER Spellcaster Fusion boss that destroys 1 card the opponent controls as a Quick Effect whenever you activate a Dracotail card or effect, and revives itself from the GY when 2+ monsters are sent to the GY.
Level 7 DARK Dragon Fusion boss that banishes cards and sets Dracotail Spells/Traps.
Level 8 Dragon Fusion that banishes a card from the opponent's field or GY as a Quick Effect.
Level 9 Fusion summoned via Faimena on the opponent's turn to pop cards, draw cards, and trigger Dracotail Fusion Material effects.
